Additionally, Daucic acid is also linked to WRL68, which is a target of another compound, 9-Hydroxy-12-oxo-10-octadecenoic acid, which also targets Jurkat. This suggests that Daucic acid may act through multiple intermediates to influence Jurkat, potentially through different mechanisms. The integration of these pathways highlights the complexity of the relationship, with Daucic acid possibly serving as a starting point for a broader network of interactions that ultimately affect Jurkat. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
